blocks.name: page_size
blocks.line: Mach Virtual Memory Statistics: \((?P<key>page size) of (?P<value>\d+ bytes)\)

fixes: Line 0 is the report title carrying one value, the page size. The page_size block puts the title in `key`, so the row reads `Mach_Virtual_Memory_Statistics = 16384 bytes`. The value then sits under a name that is not the one the tool prints for it. Change the line pattern so the key is the printed name of the value, for example `Mach Virtual Memory Statistics: \((?P<key>page size) of (?P<value>\d+ bytes)\)`, which gives the row `page_size = 16384 bytes`.
